properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's hijack detection lists event 172967 at confidence 8 (Cloudflare's high band is 8 and above), first seen 2026-11-17T02:40:30Z, last seen 2026-11-17T06:19:28Z, by 28 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Prefixes: 43.242.96.0/23, 103.156.68.0/23, 155.126.176.0/23, 182.255.60.0/22. Cloudflare's evidence: irr new origin invalid, irr old origin invalid, rpki new origin invalid. Routing data alone doesn't tell a deliberate hijack (BO-H-4A) from an operator error (BO-H-4B) or a legitimate change the detector misreads (BO-H-4C). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

properties.title: Route leak: AS9304 (HGC Global Communications Limited) leaked up to 134 prefixes (Cloudflare Radar)
properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's route-leak detection lists 1 provider-customer-provider leak by this network since 2026-11-19T04:22:01Z, 1 still open; the largest carried 134 prefixes from 4 origin networks and was seen by 50 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Path (upstream > leaker > customer): AS6939 (Hurricane Electric LLC) > AS9304 (HGC Global Communications Limited) > AS23764. Event ID: 674811. A leak can send traffic the long way round or drop it; most are export mistakes (BO-H-4B). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

properties.title: Nevada Power Company: demand 100% below what its forecast implies, 4 h (EIA-930)
properties.summary: Nevada Power Company (NEVP), which balances southern Nevada, reported 0 MW of demand to EIA for the hour to 07:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026, against its day-ahead forecast of 4,017 MW. Its demand usually runs at 110% of its forecast (the median of the 168 hours before), so about 4,417 MW was expected: 100% below. Demand stayed 25% or more below that for 4 hours in a row, 06:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026 to 10:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026, through the newest hour read, about 17,092 MWh less than expected. A gap like this fits customers losing power (a storm, strikes on the grid, a failure) and also a forecast miss, batteries charging or a reporting error; EIA-930 figures are preliminary and balancing authorities correct them within days. Reported by the balancing authority to EIA; Blackout measures the gap and does not assess the cause. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (20 Nov 2026).

baseline_ref.window: the balancing authority's own ratio of demand to day-ahead forecast in the 168 hours before the 24-hour window: its median, with the line 25% under it or 1.5 times as far under it as the 1st percentile, whichever is further (BO-IND-16)
